newsitem.title: USA: North America bunkers down on sinking world prices.
newsitem.headline: North America bunkers down on sinking world prices.

text.p: North American bunker prices fell in choppy, slow trade late this week, hit hard by the slump in values overseas, players said Thursday.
"Amsterdam-Rotterdam took a significant hit. Prices worldwide are down. It's not surprising we are in the tank," said one East Coast trader.
Bunker prices in the ARA were at their lowest levels in five months amid ample supply due to thin demand, and Singapore shed $1 to $2 a tonne on weak cargo prices.
Houston material on the U.S. Gulf Coast took the biggest hit, down $7 by late Thursday to $104/105 for 380 CST.
